# Debrid Services Comparison

> Compare pricing, 329 supported file hosts, Usenet, refund policies, speed tests and published limits across 12 debrid services. Interactive web app with open-source, human-verified data.

## Site

- [Services and benefits](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#what-are-debrid-services): what a debrid service is and what it does.
- [Choosing a service](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#choosing-the-right-service): feature matrix and quick decision table.
- [Pricing](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#debrid-pricing-comparison): prices by provider and subscription term.
- [Service limits](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#service-limits): slots, size limits, traffic caps, IP rules and free tiers.
- [Supported hosts](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#supported-file-hosts): search which services support a host or pasted URL.
- [Usenet support](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#usenet-support): services that accept NZBs.
- [Adult hosts](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#adult-content-file-hosts): adult host support by service.
- [Policies](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#refund-policies-legal): official terms, privacy and refund links.
- [Speed tests](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#debrid-speed-test): official provider speed-test pages.
- [Tools and apps](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#debrid-resources-tools): media centers, add-ons, managers and proxies.
- [Important information](https://debridcompare.pages.dev/#disclaimers): accuracy notes and disclaimers.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/fynks/debrid-services-comparison): data files, contribution guide and issue tracker.
- [README](https://github.com/fynks/debrid-services-comparison/blob/main/README.md): full written reference.
